integrity: Analytic stochastic-order proof; exact rational finite stress tests and exponential examples; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact optimality is within fixed two-two partitions of four distinguished independent atomless goods; other backgrounds must have identical distributions on both sides. No claim for arbitrary cardinalities, atomic ties or correlated utilities.
title: Extremal pairing for ex-post envy-freeness of stochastically ordered lottery goods
